english.explanation: Zygotes undergo mitotic divisions to form a multicellular structure called a sporophyte. This generation produces spores through meiosis, initiating the haploid phase in the life cycle. The sporophyte phase alternates with the gametophyte phase, completing the life cycle of plants and some algae.
